{{recipe}}

== Ingredients ==
* 3 medium [[Cookbook:Apple|apples]], peeled and cut up
* 2–3 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tablespoons]] white [[Cookbook:Granulated Sugar|granulated sugar]]
* 2 tablespoons [[Cookbook:Lemon|lemon]] juice
* 1 tablespoon [[Cookbook:Rosewater|rose]] or [[Cookbook:Orange Flower Water|orange flower water]]
* 1 dash of salt

== Procedure ==
# Place half the apples and the remaining ingredients in [[Cookbook:Blender|blender]].
# Cover and blend until coarsely chopped, 20–30 seconds.
# Add remaining apples; blend until coarsely chopped.

== Notes, tips, and variations ==
* Rose water and orange flower water can be found in gourmet and specialty shops.
